content.text:
I submitted index 3 (Sb fraction 0.30) as the best composition on this Pb–Sb–O line. Its EQE was 0.034%, the highest of the five I measured.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.22 | 0.012 |
| **3** | **0.30** | **0.034** |
| 4 | 0.36 | 0.019 |
| 12 | 0.50 | 0.0019 |
| 21 | 0.65 | 0.0016 |

- **Pb-rich compositions work much better.** Activity peaks around Sb 0.30 and drops about tenfold at Sb 0.50 (where the Pb2Sb2O7 phase would be) and on the Sb-rich side.
- **The true peak is still uncertain.** I measured only 5 of the 29 compositions. The best one could be index 2 (Sb 0.27), which I didn't measure because I ran out of EQE measurements. The Gaussian-process model had ranked index 2 second only to index 3.
- **I didn't use any XRD measurements.** The Pb2Sb2O7 and PbSb2O6 labels above are inferred from the metal ratio alone, not confirmed from diffraction data.
